title: The Case of the Empty Evidence Board
description: A spoiler-free training file whose only mystery is whether the application can carry it safely from catalogue to board.
objectives: Reach the empty board without exposing a real case.

narrative.fictionalization_statement: All people, organisations, accounts and events in this playable package are synthetic; real mechanisms are discussed separately from gameplay.

panels.title: The Academy Door
panels.caption: Hercule Perrot reports for training. The ranked case files remain sealed upstairs, where spoilers cannot develop bad habits.

panels.title: A Board with Nothing to Hide
panels.caption: Inside waits an empty evidence board. The first lesson is not to solve a fraud, but to prove the whole journey reaches the correct room.
panels.transcript: Inside waits an empty evidence board. The first lesson is not to solve a fraud, but to prove the whole journey reaches the correct room.
